newsitem.title: INDIA: India May sugar output plummets to 451,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: India May sugar output plummets to 451,000 tonnes.

text.p: India produced 451,000 tonnes of sugar in May, sharply lower than the output of 1.52 million tonnes in the same month last year, two industry associations said on Tuesday.

The Indian Sugar Mills Association and the National Federation of Cooperative Sugar Factories Ltd said in a joint statement that sugar output during October 1996-May 1997 was 12.74 million tonnes against 15.44 million tonnes in the same period a year earlier.

Sugar despatches from factories in May amounted to 1.20 million tonnes for domestic consumption and 12,000 tonnes for exports. In May 1996, despatches were 1.14 million tonnes for internal consumption and 58,000 tonnes for exports, the statement said.
Sugar stocks on May 31 stood at 11.01 million tonnes compared with 11.63 million tonnes on the same date in 1996, it added.
